method: Practical engineering fundamentals and sound software lifecycle execution
Evidence of clear reasoning, structured communication, and technical depth
Balanced focus on domain competence, trade-off analysis, and team collaboration

entry-level: Grasp of core data structures, basic algorithms, and clean syntax
Ability to articulate logic, ask clarifying questions, and receive feedback openly
Hands-on familiarity with modern frameworks and version control through projects or internships
mid-level: Autonomous delivery of production features and reliable bug diagnosis
Clear design of modular, maintainable, and well-tested services
Familiarity with common distributed systems primitives (caching, databases, message queues)
senior: End-to-end architectural leadership across complex, ambiguous problem spaces
Rigorous trade-off evaluation between performance, maintainability, and delivery speed
Proactive identification of scaling bottlenecks, security risks, and cross-team dependencies
staff-plus: Strategic technical vision aligning system architecture with business initiatives
Proven ability to guide technical strategy, de-risk multi-year migrations, and elevate standards across teams
Deep organizational influence and exemplary judgment under extreme ambiguity

swe: Clean modular code design, idiomatic language patterns, and pragmatic testing
Strong intuition for runtime complexity and data access latency
ml-data: Rigorous understanding of model evaluation, data pipelines, and feature stores
Production awareness of inference latency, drift monitoring, and batch vs stream trade-offs
sre-infra: High availability, automated failover, disaster recovery, and infrastructure as code
Deep observability (SLOs/SLAs, metrics, logs, tracing) and incident postmortem discipline
pm-design: User empathy, crisp problem definition, hypothesis testing, and product metrics
Seamless alignment of design fidelity with engineering feasibility
em-lead: High-trust team leadership, continuous coaching, and clear career pathing
Balancing technical debt reduction with product roadmap delivery
quant: Mathematical precision, high-throughput low-latency execution, and statistical validation
Deep understanding of concurrency, memory layout, and risk-adjusted return

frequentThemes.shape: Analyze trade-offs between consistency, latency, and operational simplicity in a real-world scenario
Past experience where candidate took end-to-end ownership of a challenging technical delivery
